data.source_title: Measuring quality indicators in the operating room: cleaning and turnover time
data.locator: Abstract; cleaning-time sample and reported mean
data.source_setting: 25-room academic surgical center in the interior of São Paulo State, Brazil; about 2,177 surgeries/month and 73/day.
data.source_n: 101 operations for cleaning duration; 60 operations for interval between cases.
data.source_evidence_basis: Author-reported mean from observed cleaning-time sample (101 surgeries).
data.limitations: Single university hospital; exact observation dates and dispersion are not reported in the abstract. Cleaning time is concurrent with other turnover activity, not equivalent to full room turnover.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Use only as an external cleaning-task benchmark; do not treat as a local measured value or add it mechanically to turnover because tasks may overlap.
